summary: ```# 【Marvelous Designer】Learning Day - Hat Making Collection p01 final ## Introduction In this video, we will learn how to make a hat in Marvelous Designer. If you have any questions during the process, feel free to send a message. ## Getting Started Let's get started! The basics of making hats involve drawing a circle first. This circle should be larger than our head since this represents the hat. ### Positioning the Hat 1. Use the positioning tool located in the upper right corner, resembling a small hammer. 2. Position it on the head and switch to the black and white surface for better visibility. 3. Center the hat with your head. ### Adjusting Gravity Since the 3D space has gravity, set the gravity to 0 to prevent the hat from falling down. After modifying the physical properties, allow the hat to support itself and then adjust the gravity again. ## Fixing the Hat Using a fake sewing needle, fix the hat to the virtual model's head to start modifying it. Without this fix, the hat will not stay in place. ### Creating the Hat's Top 1. Use the inner line tool to create a hole at the top of the hat. 2. This hole must be sized correctly; if it's too large, the hat will fall through, and if too small, it won't fit. ### Adjusting the Hat's Shape 1. After creating the hole, adjust the side board to form the hat's shape. 2. Use the fake sewing tool to fix the board to the virtual model's hair. ## Sewing the Hat 1. Measure the circumference of the circle and draw a rectangular board. 2. Sew this board to the top and side boards to form a complete hat. 3. Use the line to sew, pressing the `Shift` key to sew between multiple sections. ### Simulating the Hat After sewing, start simulating the hat. If the overall effect looks soft, increase the physical properties of the fabric, especially the bending strength. ## Adjusting the Fabric Properties 1. The bending strength controls how stiff the board will be. 2. You can harden the board directly, but be aware that the visibility of the effect may be unclear. ### Finalizing the Hat's Shape 1. Adjust the folding angle of the sewing line to create sharper folds. 2. Return to the original seam allowance after making adjustments. ## Working with Different Fabrics - For softer fabrics, use the default settings. - For harder fabrics, like cowhide, adjust the bending strength accordingly. ### Creating Waves and Soft Effects To create softer or wave-like effects, adjust the bending strength and the fabric properties. ## Adding Decorative Elements 1. Use the editor to create additional features like a ribbon tie or a butterfly knot. 2. Import any necessary files and apply them to your design. ## Making a Baseball Cap 1. Draw a triangle and create a polygon along the shape. 2. Use the line sewing tool to sew the pieces together. 3. Adjust the material properties to simulate a baseball cap. ### Final Adjustments - Check the alignment and stability of the hat. - Make any necessary adjustments to ensure the hat fits well on the model's head. ## Conclusion Thank you for joining this session on making hats in Marvelous Designer. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out to the community or revisit the video for more insights. ### Contact Information For further inquiries or support, please join our QQ group where we discuss various techniques and share resources related to Marvelous Designer. ```
